answer: A ridge-top weather co-op issues only as many voting staves as there are instrument pads on the exposed summit. Enrollment welds a uniquely braided velvet thermocouple into the pad and publishes its resistance fingerprint bound to one signing key. At audit the co-op ferry carries the probe to the harbor calibration dock, re-measures the braid, and demands a fresh nonce signature from that key. A second claimant on the same pad forfeits the season bond. Spinning up a hundred sockpuppets means buying, welding, and calibrating a hundred scarce pads, so each fake identity bears full physical cost.
